title: The Clear Quran by Dr. Mustafa Khattab
description: A modern English translation of the Quran's meaning, written in plain language a first-time reader can follow.
bestFor: Reading Quran meanings in clear English
trustNote: Use translations as meanings, not as a replacement for the Arabic Quran.

title: Welcome to Islam
description: A support site for new Muslims, with short introductory lessons and practical next steps.
trustNote: The earlier book attribution was unclear, so this now points to the identifiable official site.

title: Quran.com
description: Free Quran access on web and mobile, with translations, transliteration, and audio recitation.
trustNote: Useful for study links. Treat the translation wording as meaning rather than as the Arabic itself.

title: Muslim Pro
description: An everyday app for prayer times, Quran reading, and finding the Qibla.
trustNote: Always confirm prayer times with a local masjid when needed.

title: New Muslim Academy
description: Beginner courses and articles written specifically for people who became Muslim recently.
trustNote: Good for foundations. Take personal rulings to a qualified teacher.

title: Yaqeen Institute for Islamic Research
description: Articles, videos, and infographics that answer faith questions, doubts, and spirituality with sourced research.
trustNote: Helpful for learning context without turning early Islam into debate overload.

title: Bayyinah TV
description: Quran and Arabic courses that start from the alphabet, so a complete beginner can use them.
trustNote: Use as a learning aid alongside local teachers when possible.

title: ICNA New Muslim Support
description: A North American Muslim organization that runs education and outreach and can connect you with people locally.
bestFor: Finding community support in North America
trustNote: Local programs vary, so confirm details with the nearest chapter or masjid.

title: WhyIslam
description: Plain introductions to Islam, one-on-one conversations, and support material for new Muslims.
bestFor: Simple explanations for you or family members
trustNote: Useful for gentle public education and first questions.

title: New Muslim Guide - Prayer
description: Beginner explanations of prayer: how to prepare, when each prayer falls, and what to learn first.
bestFor: Learning prayer basics step by step
trustNote: Scholars differ on some of the details. Use it as a beginner guide and ask locally about the rest.

title: New Muslim Guide
description: A broad online guide that covers worship, beliefs, manners, and the everyday basics.
trustNote: Best used for foundations, not as a personalized fatwa source.

title: Quran Recitation by Mishary Rashid Alafasy
description: Clear, unhurried recitation to listen to while you get used to how the Quran sounds.
trustNote: Listen slowly and pair recitation with a teacher when learning to recite.

title: Ramadan Resources by Yaqeen Institute
description: Ramadan articles and reflections, plus practical reminders for getting ready and keeping worship going.
trustNote: Personal fasting exceptions should be reviewed with a qualified local scholar.

title: Khalil Center - Muslim Mental Health
description: Therapy and support services for Muslims, from clinicians who take the faith side seriously.
trustNote: This is not emergency care. If there is immediate danger, use crisis services.

title: Mental Health and the Muslim Convert Experience
description: An article on the emotional side of converting: identity shifts, loneliness, and what actually helps.
trustNote: Educational support only. For a crisis or ongoing distress, get clinical help.

title: SeekersGuidance
description: Free courses and a question-and-answer service on the Islamic sciences, taught by qualified scholars.
trustNote: Good for structured knowledge. Ask locally about your own circumstances.

title: Being Muslim: A Practical Guide by Asad Tarsin
description: A practical handbook on worship, spirituality, and community life, written for new and returning Muslims.
bestFor: A calm physical book for foundations
trustNote: Use as general education and pair it with a local teacher for personal questions.

title: New Muslim Guide - Food and Drink
description: Beginner guidance on halal food: reading ingredients, eating out, and knowing when you have checked enough.
trustNote: Ingredient and certification details vary by country, so ask locally when you are unsure.

title: Seerah Series by Yasir Qadhi
description: A long, detailed lecture series on the life of Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.
trustNote: This goes deeper than a first-week resource. Take it slowly.

title: New Muslim Guide - Purification
description: A written guide to wudu, ghusl, and the basics of ritual purification.
bestFor: Learning wudu and ghusl without video pressure
trustNote: Sensitive details should be discussed with a trusted teacher if you are unsure.

title: IslamicFinder Zakat Calculator
description: An online zakat calculator that walks through the usual categories of wealth and gives you a rough figure.
bestFor: Learning how zakat calculators are structured
trustNote: Calculator output is not a ruling. Ask a qualified scholar about your own finances.

title: Convert Stories - The Deen Show
description: Video interviews with people who became Muslim. Good for the days you feel like the only one.
trustNote: Stories are personal experiences, not sources for rulings.

title: Fortress of the Muslim
description: A widely used collection of duas and dhikr, each one sourced to the Quran or Sunnah.
trustNote: This replaces an anonymous PDF mirror with an identifiable publisher page.

title: AboutIslam - New Muslims
description: Short articles and FAQs for new Muslims working through questions about faith, identity, family, and community.
trustNote: Use as supportive reading and confirm detailed rulings with qualified scholars.

title: Tarteel AI - Quran Recitation Helper
description: An app that listens while you recite and flags where you slipped, for memorization and recitation practice.
trustNote: App feedback is a practice aid, not a replacement for a teacher.

title: New Muslim Guide - Purification
description: Step-by-step explanations of wudu, ghusl, and the wider rules of purity, written for beginners.
trustNote: Differences of opinion exist in some details, so ask locally for personal cases.

title: Naseeha Mental Health
description: A Muslim mental health helpline and support service for when you need to talk to someone.
bestFor: Muslim mental health support and helpline routing
trustNote: Use emergency services or crisis lines immediately if there is danger or risk of self-harm.

title: Islamic Relief USA Zakat FAQ
description: Plain answers to common zakat and giving questions, from a named charity rather than an anonymous page.
trustNote: Personal zakat calculations should be checked with a qualified scholar or trusted zakat institution.

title: LaunchGood Zakat Policy
description: One giving platform's published policy on which campaigns count as zakat eligible, and why.
bestFor: Seeing how a platform documents zakat eligibility
trustNote: Platform policies do not replace personal fiqh review for your own finances.

title: Yaqeen Institute - Dhul Hijjah Resources
description: A collection of Dhul Hijjah reflections and reminders, with simple worship ideas for the first ten days.
bestFor: Preparing for the first ten days of Dhul Hijjah
trustNote: Use it for spiritual preparation and ask a qualified person about personal rulings.

title: Nusuk Hajj Official Platform
description: The official Hajj platform, run under the supervision of the Saudi Ministry of Hajj and Umrah, for eligible pilgrims.
organization: Nusuk Hajj / Ministry of Hajj and Umrah
bestFor: Checking official Hajj registration and travel routing
trustNote: Hajj travel rules change. Confirm the current requirements through official sources before you spend money.

title: New Muslim Academy - Quran Etiquette
description: Guidance on handling the mushaf, reading translations, and Quran etiquette, written so you do not panic about getting it wrong.
trustNote: Detailed purity questions should still be reviewed with a qualified local teacher.

title: Yaqeen Institute - Life of the Prophet
description: A large set of videos and articles on the Prophet's life and character, from a named research institute.
bestFor: Gradual seerah listening and character reflection
trustNote: Take it slowly. There is no need to get through a long series in one go.

title: SeekersGuidance - Study the Life of the Prophet
description: A short piece on how to study seerah properly, through structured courses and reliable teachers.
trustNote: Good for structured learning paths. Take personal religious questions to a qualified teacher.

title: New Muslim Academy - Following the Messenger
description: A beginner introduction to why Muslims follow the example of Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.
bestFor: New Muslim orientation to the Prophet's example
trustNote: Use as beginner framing and continue with qualified teachers for deeper seerah.
